nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The houses along the street are still behind you. A few more steps in and all you can hear is yourself walking.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Nothing under the slide. It comes out facing the bench; whoever waits there doesn’t have to turn their head.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: Off the street, in a courtyard. The slide faces an empty bench; a narrow way leads between the blocks.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Nobody on the bench. A narrow way between the blocks, light at the far end.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The handrail turns. From here you can see as far as the landing.

choices.text: Count to the landing from here.
Stay on the level for now.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: At the top of the count you realise you’ve included the landing as a step.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: From the courtyard I could count steps only as far as the first landing. I didn’t go up.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Counting again won’t get you further. If you want to see what’s there, go up.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Leave the steps uncounted. There’s a way between the blocks on the level.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A patch of green on the shaded side of the bed. It lifts. There’s a separate shadow underneath.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You saw a green animal on the concrete beside the planter. You cannot say what it is.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It’s close. If you don’t look straight at it, it could be a bit fallen off the flower bed.

choices.text: Look more closely at its head.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You find the eye first. The head has turned. The rest of it hasn’t.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A flat bill, a flat tail. You can’t tell whether the tail’s touching the ground.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The green animal has a flat bill and a flat tail. Nothing else about it is clear.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Keep an eye on the crack in the paving. It hasn’t crossed it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: After a bit the shadow looks sharper. It’s holding its head higher.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You remember a picture in the textbook. A caption underneath. All you can recall of the caption is how short it was.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: I recall a textbook picture with a short caption. I don’t remember what it said.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Better leave the caption blank for now.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: That bit of green again. This time it’s the shadow you catch first.
